dictionary: D1 source-normalized y, unchanged B2 reconstruction, unchanged native cell-integral probes and apparatus identity edge terms; no fitted operator or Hamiltonian coefficient.
hypotheses: Separate numerical validity, static source moments, scalar response, basis-invariant centroid/cosine spectra, state-current algebra, zero-delay moments, and static-only Galerkin prediction. There is no aggregate theory-pass gate.
kick_window: Both 3x3 current disturbance relative to vacuum AND mismatch relative to continuum, each plus numerical guard, <=1% at a registered strength; no selective or delayed-state guarantee follows.
predictor: The three-sine source-span Galerkin generator is determined solely by static C,K. Compare its own-system response at held-out times; no adjustment from time data.
prior_inspection: D1 results including static covariance and postmeasurement moments were inspected before R1. R1 current matrices, K, new-time responses and coincident-two-K controls have not been evaluated before this freeze. Thresholds are prospective R1 operational targets, not universal physical bounds.
stop_rule: One production attempt per registered point; no larger N, fit, tolerance change, retry or automatic extension. Every failure remains reported.
massive_rule: Withheld under every R1 outcome. Preserve N22 completed result, B2 N20 component failure, D1 failed moments, and P1 parent obligations.
scope: Finite source/evolution diagnostics and a separate experimental protocol. Invariants remove invertible mixing inside a fixed probe span, not a change of span, boundary condition or ground state. Neither a continuum theorem nor empirical GRUT validation is inferred.
